name: Arleen Bocatija Rojas
office: City of Carson, Member of the City Council, 4th District

items.text: Arleen Bocatija Rojas is the incumbent City Council member for Carson's 4th District, running for a second term. Her campaign says she spent 35 years as a Los Angeles police officer. Her campaign says her priorities include expanding community policing, fixing streets, improving lighting and attracting businesses. In her Voter Guide statement, she said public safety is the city's biggest need. She added that she helped establish a Public Safety Task Force and launched a community policing program to address property crime and illegal street takeovers.
